Report as delivered in chat (plain text)

Satellite jobs, Wed Oct 28: 30 new postings since yesterday, with 18 at Amazon Leo, 12 at Eutelsat and none at Telesat. Most of the Eutelsat additions are for IRIS², the EU's planned satellite constellation. There are 1,122 open roles in total, and all three career sites loaded fine today. Amazon Leo has 1,003 openings: 18 new and 15 closed since yesterday. Most are in hardware development (306) and software development (242), and over half are in Redmond (534). Its search also returns any posting that mentions Leo or Kuiper, so a few roles from neighboring Amazon teams may be in there. Eutelsat, including OneWeb, has 69 openings: 12 new and 2 closed. Over half are engineering roles (36), mostly in Issy-les-Moulineaux near Paris and in Turin. Telesat has 50 openings: none new and 1 closed. They're mostly in Ottawa and centered on Lightspeed, Telesat's low-orbit satellite network. I've put the new postings in the thread below, and the spreadsheet with every open role is attached.
